This experience was genuinely upsetting and shook my trust. I did not expect such irresponsible behavior. Please ensure that you give correct information to students instead of making false commitments just to secure payments.

I would not recommend this institute to anyone based on my experience.

You had negotiated extensively citing personal issues and chose to proceed by paying a nominal token of ₹2000 to reserve a seat. 

At the time, we clearly mentioned that batch availability is subject to confirmation. When the exact slot you preferred wasn’t immediately available, we promptly offered alternative timings—but unfortunately, there was no flexibility from your end.

Despite this, and as a gesture of our commitment to fairness, your full amount was refunded the very next day—without any deductions, delays, or questions asked.

It’s therefore surprising to see this being portrayed as “misleading” or “unprofessional,” when in reality, we acted swiftly, transparently, and in line with our principles.

We believe feedback should be balanced and factual. Your review, unfortunately, does not reflect the complete picture.

We request you to reconsider and correct the narrative accordingly.
